# Common Sense Media

> > Common Sense Media is the leading independent source for age-appropriate media reviews, recommendations, and parenting guidance for families navigating entertainment and technology.

Common Sense Media provides trusted, expert reviews and curated lists of movies, TV shows, books, and games organized by age appropriateness. The organization helps parents make informed decisions about their children's media consumption through detailed content ratings, parental guidance, and quality seal recognition.

## Key Topics

- Age-appropriate content
- Media reviews
- Parental guidance
- Content ratings
- Family entertainment
- Movie recommendations
- TV recommendations
- Book recommendations
- Common Sense Selections
- Digital wellness
- Child safety
- Content filtering
- Best-of lists
- LGBTQ+ representation
- Educational content

## Core Resources

- [Common Sense Media Homepage](https://www.commonsensemedia.org): Leading source for family entertainment and tech recommendations
- [Common Sense Selections](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/seal): Quality seal recognizing best movies, TV shows, books, and games for families
- [Parenting, Media, and Everything in Between](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/articles): Expert parenting guides covering digital wellness and child safety topics

## Movie Recommendations

- [Best Movies for Kids](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/movie-lists): Curated age-appropriate movie recommendations for family entertainment
- [50 Modern Movies All Kids Should Watch Before They're 12](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/lists/50-modern-movies-all-kids-should-watch-before-theyre-12): Curated list of 50 post-2000 films recommended for children under 12
- [The Best Kid's Entertainment of 2024](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/best-of-2021-form-submission): 2024 roundup of top kids' entertainment across movies, TV, books, apps

## TV Show Recommendations

- [Best TV for Kids](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/tv-lists): Comprehensive TV show recommendations including cartoons and educational content
- [Best Kids' TV Shows on Netflix](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/best-of-lists/best-kids-tv-shows-on-netflix): Netflix kids' TV show recommendations filtered by age and content quality
- [Best Kids' TV Shows on Disney Plus](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/best-of-lists/best-kids-tv-shows-on-disney-plus): Curated Disney Plus TV recommendations for children by age appropriateness

## Book Recommendations

- [Best Books for Kids](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/book-lists): Recommended children's books including classics and contemporary bestsellers
- [50 Books All Kids Should Read Before They're 12](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/lists/50-books-all-kids-should-read-before-theyre-12): Essential reading list of 50 books recommended for elementary-age children
- [How to Raise a Reader](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/articles/how-to-raise-a-reader): Eight practical tips for encouraging children's reading habits and literacy
- [Growing Up Queer: Thoughtful Books About LGBTQ+ Youth](https://www.commonsensemedia.org/lists/growing-up-queer-thoughtful-books-about-lgbtq-youth): Curated LGBTQ+ affirming books for youth with diverse representation
